title: Latest (after 17.12) nightly Builds (automatic) have a broken watchface
symptom: The nightly builds after 17.12 have a broken watchface. On the SmartWatch, the xDrip-Watchface is only black and shows nothing.
cause: The cause is not explicitly stated in the thread, but a maintainer indicates they know what is causing it and a new version is prepared.
fix: A new version (xDrip-plus-20161222-51bd62f.apk) was provided and confirmed to resolve the problem.
evidence_quote: Please try this version and let me know if it resolves the problem: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/download/2016.12.22b/xDrip-plus-20161222-51bd62f.apk
